content: Ligand 1 is my reference and atom 0 is its pyridine 4-methyl. The central ring is the productive axis now, so I am varying the substituent at its best position - ortho to the anilide - rather than moving it around again. A methyl there was worth +0.03. The interesting comparison is a chlorine: on the central ring in the para series a fluorine cost 0.01-0.05, which is what made me wrongly write off that ring entirely, and chlorine sits between the two in size while matching fluorine's electron-withdrawing character. If chlorine behaves like the methyl, then that position just wants bulk and fluorine was too small to fill it; if it behaves like the fluorine, the position wants electron density and I should try alkyls and alkoxys only. Either way it resolves the contradiction between my two central-ring results. I combine it with the meta geometry, which is the single biggest gain in the series. Expected product: about 302 Da.
